scope: Whole offline verification, receipt and reporting transactions; local macOS arm64 and CPython3.12. No live provider or model performance claim.
candidate_identity: Measured source manifest and artifacts are retained. Committed runtime source is identical; two nonfunctional test/manifest edits are individually documented under post_measurement_changes.

environment.storage: APFS sparse image on the same external TB4 volume
environment.execution: Sequential fresh processes; one computational worker; filesystem warmed by qualification; no other builds or tests during timing. Thermal state not established.

candidate_scope: Whole native evidence transactions; Python workers import the fixed baseline wheel and call the installed native extension directly. Public candidate SDK/CLI routing is qualified separately.
normalization: Only declared report destination paths; all other outputs, signed receipt bytes and report file hashes match.
resource_scope: Fresh-process wall, total user/system CPU and peak RSS include imports, identity checks, serialization and output hashing. Operation timer spans transaction steps and excludes identity checks and final output hashing. RSS is whole process, not incremental Rust memory.

source.resolution: make verify v5 stopped at a docs link warning; docs-only correction then separate docs-check and examples-check passed. Earlier component passes remain applicable.

native_python.skip: Host filesystem rejects non-UTF-8 filename before either implementation can inspect it.

limitations: Four observations per candidate/workload; no tail-latency or population confidence claim.
High wall-time variation in some cells is retained; no fastest-run selection.
Small native and judge fixtures do not establish large-pack or collection performance.
Python control optimization is only the recorded interval hash-prefix change, not an exhaustive Python redesign.
Both Rust modes have higher peak RSS in every measured workload. Allocation causes are unprofiled.
Candidate SDK/CLI installed-route tests are separate; comparison Python workers use baseline wheel and direct FFI.
No live OCI/GPU/provider qualification, Linux descriptor execution qualification or Windows port.
Current Unix-specific native code and CPython3.12 companion are not a qualified cross-platform release.

post_measurement_changes.reason: Pinned Ruff0.16.7 requires parentheses around a conditional lambda; earlier formatting used0.14.6.
Remove an extra blank line at EOF reported after staging new files.

installed_candidate_root_wheel.scope: Separate installed public SDK/CLI qualification, not the root wheel used by timing workers.

final_delivery_sdist.relation_to_measured_sdist: Only one test formatting change and CLI manifest EOF whitespace; AST and parsed TOML equal, compiled Rust source bytes and measured binary hashes unchanged. Prior extracted wheel build evidence reused explicitly.
